title: Momento is a Prediction Intelligence Platform
decision: Designed as an intelligence platform rather than a single prediction algorithm.
reason: Algorithms evolve. Intelligence architecture must survive.

title: Raw Events Are Immutable
reason: Replayability and trust require permanent historical truth.

title: Observation Engine Is the Entry Point
decision: All external data must pass through observation processing.

title: Explainability Is Mandatory
decision: No prediction exists without explanation metadata.
